card.name: Words leading up to "harm" or injury
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "in", "cause", "could", "serious" or "physical" that come right before an expected word like harm, injury or risk. Seen in warnings about seizures, loss of consciousness, sleep-related activities and falls.

modes.label: Cause or result in
modes.description: Verbs or prepositions such as "cause" and "result in" that lead into harm to oneself or others.
modes.example: engaging in any activity where sudden loss of consciousness could<< cause>> serious harm to themselves or others

modes.label: Serious or physical before injury
modes.description: Adjectives such as "serious" or "physical" placed just before the word injuries, harm or risk.
modes.example: Some of these events may result in<< serious>> injuries, including death.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict harm-related words such as harm, harmed and harmful next.
card.plain: It fires on the small words just before a warning names the harm or injury that could follow.
